skills.name: scan-website
skills.description: Scan any public website against 19 agent-readiness standards and receive score + failing checks.
skills.when_to_use: Use when you need to check how ready any public website is for AI-agents (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity) before citing, recommending or building on it.

skills.name: get-page-markdown
skills.description: Retrieve a curated markdown version of a code-lieshout.nl page for agent consumption.
skills.when_to_use: Use when you need fast, clean context from a code-lieshout.nl page (services, pricing, FAQ, blog) without parsing HTML — via the .md-variant or Accept: text/markdown.
